what: Vendor-behaviour probes in throwaway EMQX 5.8.9 brokers (lab store, --network none, generated env values, outputs are booleans/shapes only); run as direct labpodman commands from the review session on 2026-11-23
image: docker.io/emqx/emqx:5.8.9 (copied from dev-d store, image 3f60addfad2b there)

probes.setup: EMQX_DASHBOARD__DEFAULT_PASSWORD and EMQX_NODE__COOKIE set to generated values
probes.expression: maps:is_key/get on emqx:get_raw_config([dashboard]) and ([node]) compared with the env values in-broker
probes.meaning: the RAW config the product readback hashes per root contains env-provided secrets

probes.setup: 6 payloads in a connector description: quote break, triple-quote break, backslash, brace break, ${VAR}, multi-line
probes.expression: hocon_pp:do -> file -> hocon:files, compare keys/value, search env value
probes.output: all 6: keys=[connectors], value round-trips exactly, env value absent
probes.meaning: HA strings cannot inject HOCON into the export cluster.hocon
the import parser does not resolve OS environment variables

probes.setup: SECREV_PROBE set to a generated value
probes.expression: emqx_rule_funcs:jq(Program, <<"{}">>) for Program in env, $ENV, env.SECREV_PROBE, $__loc__, input_filename
probes.meaning: rule SQL jq() exposes the broker's process environment (this device's env secrets)
